title: SpiceXplorer analysis binding
description: Binds a class/shared testbench template to per-circuit parameters (plan D-4). The resolver (Phase 2) renders template + datasheet conditions into a runnable netlist.

id.description: Analysis id (e.g. ac_open_loop, dc_op, noise, tran_step, linearity).

enabled.description: false = scaffolded but unselected: Tier 2 still assembles it (cheap), but the runner and the sim tiers (T3/T4) skip it.

params.description: Template parameter overrides for this circuit (e.g. CL, VCM, sweep ranges).

flags.description: Template feature flags (e.g. bias_wrap for the AnalogGym open-loop-in-closed-loop-bias trick).

produces.description: Metric ids this analysis is expected to produce (must exist in datasheet.metrics).
